title: fix(app-shell): a package-door permission save keeps the pending draft's values
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8HDu4gcLm3Z4tJj8SMXXi7D)_

Fixes #26837

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:Studio 包内权限集的保存,合并基底从「已发布版本」改为「当前待发布草稿」;没有草稿时仍用已发布版本。
- 为什么改:经 API 或其他入口写进草稿的 description、packageId 等编辑器不管的键,在 Studio 里勾一个格子就被已发布值覆盖,静默丢数据。
- 风险与回滚:保存前多读一次草稿;草稿读取失败时拒绝保存,提示与已发布重读失败相同(作者可再次编辑重试)。回滚即还原本 PR 的修复提交。
- 先看:`PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx` 的 `doSave` 包门分支(`base` 一行与草稿读失败判断);新测试 `PermissionMatrixEditor.packageDoorDraftBase-26837.test.tsx`;同文件新增的 `pendingDraftBody`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PermissionMatrixEditor.packageDoorDraftBase-26837.test.tsx`,预期 3 passed。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `doSave`'s package-door arm now reads the pending draft through the load's own door, `readDraftForSave`, at the address the save writes (in parallel with the existing `layered` re-read), and merges this package's slice onto the draft when one exists. With no pending draft the base is the published `effective`, and the 404 shape keeps the `?? payload` base, both as before.
- A REJECTED save-time draft read refuses the save with the same `perm.save.rereadFailed` text as the layered refusal (objectui#9420); it never falls back to the published body. `readDraftForSave` resolves a rejection as no answer and no pin, while a read that found no draft pins `If-None-Match: *`, so that pair is the failure signal.
- `mergePermissionSlice` and `EDITOR_AUTHORED_KEYS` are unchanged: measured, the key list already takes only the authored facets from the edited body. The defect was the base only.
- The unwrap of a served draft envelope (strip read decorations, objectui#8181) moves into one module-level helper, `pendingDraftBody`, used by the load and by the save base, so the two can't drift apart.
- The environment door (no `packageId`) keeps its whole-record live save unchanged.

## Why

The package door's save writes the package DRAFT, but its merge base was the PUBLISHED body. Keys the editor does not author (`description`, `packageId`, anything another door wrote) came from that base, so one Studio edit replaced a pending draft's values with published ones (or with none). The response was 200 and nothing showed an error.

## Tests

New `PermissionMatrixEditor.packageDoorDraftBase-26837.test.tsx` drives the real page, load and autosave:

1. A pending draft whose `description`, `packageId` and an out-of-scope row differ from published: every non-authored key and the out-of-scope rows reach the wire equal to the draft, and the edited row lands.
2. Control, no pending draft: the base is the published body (its `description`, no `packageId`, its rows).
3. The save-time draft read rejects: `client.save` is never called, the refusal is on the page's error strip, and `getDraftCalls === 2` proves the read ran.

## Acceptance notes

- The load-time version pin is left alone: the save-time draft read does not re-record it. A draft that moved after the load is still refused as a `409 METADATA_CONFLICT` and opens the conflict dialog, instead of being merged silently.
- When a pending draft exists, out-of-scope rows (other packages' grants) now come from the draft as well, since the draft is the document this save replaces and Publish promotes.
- `readDraftForSave` has no explicit failure flag. This PR reads failure from its documented answer/pin pair and stays inside `PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx`. An explicit flag would be a change to `DraftConflictDialog.tsx`, which is outside this card's file surface.
- Serial work in the same file: PR #26999 and PR #27064 are both still open. Neither has a hunk in the save-base region. PR #27064 edits the load path near the `draftBody` line this PR changes, so whichever lands second may need a small textual merge.
